tokens.name: plate-900
tokens.usage: Deepest navy. Ground behind menus and the solid base of HUD plates on Tier 1.

tokens.name: plate-800
tokens.usage: Surface. Cards, nav rail, sheets, menu panels.

tokens.name: plate-700
tokens.usage: Raised surface. Rows, tracks of bars and meters, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: plate-600
tokens.usage: Lines and borders. Card outlines, dividers, empty meter segments.

tokens.name: plate-glass
tokens.usage: Frosted HUD glass over the road: position, lap, standings, speedometer, item labels, callout banners. Used with blur-glass on Tier 2 and 3 so the race stays visible through it. Text on it always takes the outline treatment.

tokens.name: plate-glass-solid
tokens.usage: Glass fallback where blur is off (Tier 1, or devices without backdrop blur): more tint instead of blur, still see-through.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px top highlight and rim on glass plates, so they read as glass against sky and road.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Upper-half sheen on glass plates. Decoration only.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The dark stroke and hard drop under white display text so it reads on any part of the 3D world (sky, road, billboards).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on plate-900, plate-800, plate-700 and plate-glass (at least 12:1 on plate-700).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on plate-900, plate-800 and plate-700 (at least 6.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Unavailable headings 19px or larger and empty-slot icons on plate-800. Never for text under 19px: use ink-muted there.

tokens.name: danfo
tokens.usage: Primary. The one action per screen (RACE NOW, RUN AM BACK), the active nav item, and YOUR row in any standings or leaderboard.

tokens.name: danfo-deep
tokens.usage: The hard bottom edge and pressed state of danfo buttons.

tokens.name: on-danfo
tokens.usage: Navy text and icons on danfo (at least 11:1).

tokens.name: lagoon
tokens.usage: Social: Online, Challenge, party, bail. Never a gameplay state.

tokens.name: on-lagoon
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lagoon.

tokens.name: boost
tokens.usage: Boost: BOOST button when charged, boost callout, the boost count in the speedometer.

tokens.name: on-boost
tokens.usage: Text and icons on boost.

tokens.name: item-boost
tokens.usage: Rim of ItemSlot for self-boost items (Jollof Boost). Item slots only.

tokens.name: item-attack
tokens.usage: Rim of ItemSlot for thrown attack items (Pure Water Attack). Item slots only.

tokens.name: item-hazard
tokens.usage: Rim of ItemSlot for hazards that damage others (Tire Spike). Item slots only.

tokens.name: item-trap
tokens.usage: Rim of ItemSlot for traps dropped behind you (Banana Trap). Item slots only.

tokens.name: drift-1
tokens.usage: Drift charge stage 1 (blue): drift ring and spark trail.

tokens.name: drift-2
tokens.usage: Drift charge stage 2 (orange).

tokens.name: drift-3
tokens.usage: Drift charge stage 3 (purple), the maximum mini-turbo.

tokens.name: speed-1
tokens.usage: Speedometer arc, first fifth (cyan).

tokens.name: speed-2
tokens.usage: Speedometer arc, second fifth (green).

tokens.name: speed-3
tokens.usage: Speedometer arc, middle (yellow).

tokens.name: speed-4
tokens.usage: Speedometer arc, fourth fifth (orange).

tokens.name: speed-5
tokens.usage: Speedometer arc, top speed (red).

tokens.name: enforcer
tokens.usage: Enforcer threat (LASTMA in Season 1), hazards aimed at you, errors.

tokens.name: on-enforcer
tokens.usage: Text and icons on enforcer fills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive and failed states. Alias of enforcer: one red family.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Escaped, complete, rank up, ready. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Weak network, low storage, data prompts. Always with an icon.

tokens.name: rank-jjc
tokens.usage: Rank tier 1, JJC: badge and rank name.

tokens.name: rank-sharp-sharp
tokens.usage: Rank tier 2, Sharp Sharp.

tokens.name: rank-no-dull
tokens.usage: Rank tier 3, No Dull.

tokens.name: rank-sabi
tokens.usage: Rank tier 4, Sabi.

tokens.name: rank-odogwu
tokens.usage: Rank tier 5, Odogwu.

tokens.name: rank-chairman
tokens.usage: Rank tier 6, Chairman.

tokens.name: rank-oga-patapata
tokens.usage: Rank tier 7, Oga Patapata. Top 100 only.

tokens.name: on-rank
tokens.usage: Text on any rank fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets over live 3D. Tier 1 uses plate-900, no blur.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Countdown, results position, rank-up reveal. Outlined white on the world.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Hero moments: LAST LAP, PULL OVER!, match found.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Primary CTA label and screen titles.

styles.name: heading-l
styles.usage: Callout headlines, mode titles, rank names on profile.

styles.name: heading-m
styles.usage: Card titles, player names, callout second lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Chuks don beat your time for Third Mainland.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Secondary lines on cards and rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small button labels, tabs, chips. Uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Item names under slots, chips, timestamps.

styles.name: num-m
styles.usage: Race timer, standings positions, reward deltas.

styles.name: num-s
styles.usage: Currency chips, progress counts, stat values.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, standings row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, gaps between item slots.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Minimum safe-area inset, gaps between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps on menus.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: HUD clusters from the edge on tablets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding around RACE NOW and results headline.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, standings rows, progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, HUD plates, rank badges (small).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, mode cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Item slots, HUD buttons, avatars, speedometer.

shadow.note: Hard offset edges instead of soft blur: cheap on Tier 1 GPUs and chunky like an arcade cabinet button.

tokens.name: edge-danfo
tokens.usage: Bottom edge of primary buttons. Collapses to 0 2px 0 on press.

tokens.name: edge-plate
tokens.usage: Bottom edge of secondary buttons, tappable cards and HUD plates.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Sheets and notification cards over 3D. Tier 2 and 3 only.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tappable target in menus.

tokens.name: button-md
tokens.usage: Secondary and danger buttons.

tokens.name: button-lg
tokens.usage: Primary CTA (RACE NOW, RUN AM BACK).

tokens.name: hud-button
tokens.usage: Item slots and Boost button in a race.

tokens.name: hud-button-drift
tokens.usage: Drift button, the most-held control.

tokens.name: speedometer
tokens.usage: Diameter of the speedometer gauge.

tokens.name: nav-rail
tokens.usage: Width of the left navigation rail.

tokens.name: safe-inset
tokens.usage: Minimum inset from every edge, on top of device safe areas.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Presses, item activation, +1, boost ignition.

tokens.name: duration-medium
tokens.usage: Cards, nav changes, sheets, standings reorder.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Rank-up, results headline, tournament win. Never during a race.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Arrivals: cards, callouts, sheets.

tokens.name: ease-snap
tokens.usage: Arcade overshoot: callouts, badges, +1, rewards.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits.

blur.note: Backdrop blur for HUD glass. Tier 2 and 3 only; Tier 1 swaps to plate-glass-solid.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind every HUD glass plate.

tokens.name: blur-glass-light
tokens.usage: Lighter blur for small plates (standings rows, item labels) to save GPU.
